subject: Contract amendment: segmented on-prem footprint + additional isolated clusters
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@mountainhealth.tech>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ops Procurement <procure@mountainhealth.tech>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: segmentation & extra clusters at renewal

Hi Priyom / Marissa,

Thanks again for the call earlier — Mountain Health is preparing for our next contract cycle and we need to confirm scope and pricing to land internal approvals. A couple of priorities from infra and security: 

- We must split the Private footprint into two isolated VPCs for PHI vs non-PHI workloads.
- Add two additional isolated on-prem clusters (N+2) in our data center (SJC) behind our customer-managed firewall.
- Term: we'd prefer to extend by 18 months from July 1 to align with our EoY budget cycle.

Can you share a short amendment (SOW + pricing delta) and a network diagram that shows how Redwood will onboard the second cluster while keeping tenant isolation? Also need confirmation on KMS options and whether HSM-backed keys are supported for the PHI VPC.

Target timeline: procurement needs pricing and SOW by Friday (21 May) to route to finance. Appreciate any items we should be aware of for an air-gapped checklist.

Best,
Elena
VP Infrastructure
Mountain Health

Attachments: none in this message
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@mountainhealth.tech>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: segmentation & extra clusters at renewal

Elena — thanks for the clear priorities. High-level answers below, and I'll have a draft amendment + diagram by Thursday EOD so you can hit procurement on Friday.

- VPC segmentation: we can provision two fully isolated Private environments. Each environment gets isolated networking, separate model pinning, and tenant-level ACLs. Communication between them is blocked unless explicitly configured by you.
- Additional clusters: we can onboard two on-prem clusters in SJC. Each cluster will be provisioned into its own subnet and join the Private control plane via your customer-managed VPN. During onboarding we support a staggered cutover (blue/green) to avoid downtime.
- KMS/HSM: we support customer-managed keys via KMS integrations; for HSM-backed keys we have a validated flow using your HSM gateway — won’t be out-of-the-box but supported via our Private Ops team. Note: HSM setup typically adds 2-3 weeks to provisioning.
- Term: we can accommodate an 18-month extension; pricing delta will include reserved capacity pricing for the additional clusters.

I'll attach: draft SOW, network diagram, and a pricing spreadsheet with the amendment rows called out. If you want, Marissa can run a quick latency/cost estimate for the two clusters once we have expected peak qps.

Priyom
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOW_MtnHealth_2027.pdf; network_diagram_vpc_isolation.png; redwood-pricing-amendment.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@mountainhealth.tech>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: segmentation & extra clusters at renewal

Elena — quick note on ops impact and timelines.

From an infra ops perspective:
- Provisioning two isolated clusters (on-prem) requires: VPN tunnel + static routing, load-balancer config, and node provisioning. Estimated hands-on time: 4x engineer-days across private ops and infra.
- HSM integration: needs a runbook from your security team and a brief access window. Add ~2–3 weeks as Priyom noted.
- SLA/monitoring changes: segmented environments will each have a dedicated SLO + incident routing; we'll include per-environment runbooks in the SOW.

On pricing: the attached spreadsheet shows a blended reserved rate for the extra clusters and a line item for the segmentation effort (one-time setup). There is a modest term discount if you sign an 18-month amendment vs rolling monthly.

If procurement can accept the draft SOW by Friday we'll start the onboarding kickoff the following Monday (24 May) and target cluster onboarding completion by June 21, barring HSM delays.

—Marissa
Senior Customer Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Ops Procurement <procure@mountainhealth.tech>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@mountainhealth.tech>, Victor Hsu <victor.hsu@mountainhealth.tech>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Contract amendment: segmented on-prem footprint + additional isolated clusters

Hi Priyom / Marissa,

Thanks for the materials — received SOW and pricing. A couple of procurement clarifications before we sign: 

1) Pricing: Please confirm whether the reserved-cluster pricing is invoiced monthly or upfront for the 18-month term. Also include cancellation clauses for hardware failure events.
2) Support: We need a named escalation path and a 24x7 number for the PHI VPC environment.
3) Compliance artifacts: SOC2 evidence and a brief summary of your on-prem audit checklist. Can you append those to the SOW?

Victor will lead the final routing to finance — Victor, can you confirm the required PO format?

If you can send a final redline-ready PDF and DocuSign link by end of day Monday (24 May), procurement will aim to issue the PO by June 2.

Thanks,
Procurement Team
Mountain Health
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ops Procurement <procure@mountainhealth.tech>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@mountainhealth.tech>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Contract amendment: segmented on-prem footprint + additional isolated clusters

Team — attaching the updated SOW with the following changes per procurement: invoicing options (monthly or upfront with discount), cancellation language for hard failures, named 24x7 escalation contacts, and a short compliance appendix (SOC 2 summary + Private deployment checklist). Also included a DocuSign envelope link for signature.

Operational notes:
- If Mountain Health elects HSM-backed keys we will schedule a 2-week validation window after DocuSign completes; otherwise standard KMS takes 3–5 business days.
- Kickoff: we propose Monday, 31 May for a joint technical kickoff and an initial VPN test.

Next steps for Mountain Health: confirm billing preference (monthly vs upfront) and sign the DocuSign. If Victor can confirm PO format, we'll convert the DocuSign to an executed contract and queue the Private Ops kickoff.

Priyom
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
